examples.text: During the storm, the boat broke free from its moorings.

[…] I saw his Lady,
Wild, with a Storm of Grief! Her Hair dishevel’d!
And her loose Robes, blown, careless, by the Wind!

examples.text: The prisoners escaped by jumping over a wall.

examples.text: Luckily, I escaped with only a fine.
